en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Amro Bin Usman Al Khazzaz, from Al Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Zayd Al Shahaam,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a man upon whom it was doubtful and he did not know whether he perform Sajdah once or twice’. Heasws said: ‘So let him perform Sajdah another’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Amr ibn ‘Uthman al-Khazzaz from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Zayd al-Shahham who has said the following: “
About a man who doubts and does not know if he has performed one or two Sajdah (prostrations), abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘He performs one more Sajdah (prostration).”’
